newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: DHL Philippines plans to expand fleet.
newsitem.headline: DHL Philippines plans to expand fleet.

text.p: MANILA, July 24 (reuter) - The Philippine unit of DHL Worldwide Express plans to double its aircraft fleet to 10 next year to support its expanding operations in Asia, the president of the firm said on Thursday.
DHL Philippines president Rod Feliciano told reporters his company planned to acquire five more aircraft to to be able to expand operations in five more countries in the region.
"We are still negotiating for air rights to the additional five countries for expansion in June next year," Feliciano said.
DHL Philippines currently operates cargo flights from Manila to Hong Kong, Singapore, Taipei, Korea, Malaysia, Indonesia and the Philippines.
